ambelie_1.m: Oh my, a commoner. Get away from me. I might catch something.
r: What is a noble woman such as yourself doing in a place like this?
I would be glad to get away from a snob like you.

ambelie_10.m: Thank you. Now please leave before someone sees me talking to a commoner like you.
r: Commoner? Are you trying to insult me? Goodbye.
Whatever, you probably wouldn't even survive a forest wasp.

ambelie_2.m: I am Ambelie of the house of Laumwill in Feygard. I am sure you must have heard of me and my house.
r: Oh yes ... um ... House of Laumwill in Feygard. Of course.
I have never heard of you or your house.

ambelie_3.m: Feygard, the great city of peace. Surely you must know of it. Northwest in our great land.
r: What is a noble woman such as yourself doing in a place like this?
No, I have never heard of it.

ambelie_4.m: Pfft. That just proves everything I have heard of you savages here in the southern land. So uneducated.

ambelie_5.m: I, Ambelie, of the house of Laumwill in Feygard, am on an excursion to the southern Nor City.

ambelie_6.m: An excursion to see if Nor City really is all that I have heard about it. If it really can compare itself to the glamour of the great city of Feygard.
r: If you like it so much in Feygard, why would you even leave?
Ehh ... I'm here to ... escort you safely to Nor City.

ambelie_7.m: Don't you know of Nor City? I will take note that the savages here haven't even heard of the city.

ambelie_8.m: I am beginning to be even more certain that Nor City will never, even in my wildest dreams, be comparable to the great city of Feygard.

ambelie_9.m: All the noblewomen in Feygard keep talking about the mysterious Shadow in Nor City. I just have to see it myself.

ambelie_guild02_1.m: Why? I don't know you, commoner. Why would I be willing to trust a savage looking kid?
r: But I'm not a commoner! I'm a ... Feygard spy. These clothes are my disguise!
I'm stronger than those smug guards.

ambelie_guild02_10.m: Bread? That's not a worthy food for a noblewoman like me! Oh my, where am I?
r: If you prefer going without food in this ugly cell for a long while then I don't care.
Do you prefer to eat the floor, bad mannered woman?

ambelie_guild02_11.m: S..sorry, please ... Yes I'm hungry ... Will you give me that? *sniffs*

ambelie_guild02_12.m: Th..thanks. Now, please tell me, where am I?
r: Sorry, but I cannot reveal that to you right now. Bye.
That doesn't matter! If you behave well maybe you will be out of here sooner rather than later.
I'm not going to hurt you, I don't want to do this.

ambelie_guild02_16a.m: Then get out of my sight now!
r: I can't.Things are not that easy! Other people will get you instead of me.
They will probably kill me if I go back without you.

ambelie_guild02_16b.m: You! Don't go any further. Leave me!
r: I'm not going to hurt you.
You aren't, and my presence here is the proof!

ambelie_guild02_17b.m: I couldn't care less about you! Just ask the guards.
r: Those untrained men aren't able to defend themselves. Don't make me laugh.
Other people will get you, and they won't be as kind as me.

ambelie_guild02_18.m: Stop. Then tell me what I can do!
r: Give me something of value, and you won't see me again.
[Lie]I have enough gold, so if you give me something valuable .... The ransom we were going to ask will be covered.

ambelie_guild02_19.m: Take this and leave me, please.
r: It has been a pleasure, my lady.

ambelie_guild02_2.m: Anyway, I prefer to stay in this place for now. Get away from me!

ambelie_guild02_20.m: You already took my necklace. Leave me alone.

r: [Lie] Sorry, but I have to take you back home!

ambelie_guild02_4a.m: No! I won't go anywhere with you, commoner! Guards, guards!

ambelie_guild02_4b.m: (You tap her on the back of the head with the handle of your weapon, and she falls unconscious)

ambelie_guild02_4c.m: Wha... what are you referring to?
r: Sorry. Time to sleep! (Knock her out)
I'm here to detain you, and then ask for a ransom.

ambelie_guild02_5.m: NO! I've said no! Don't bother me. Get away from me!
r: [Whispering] You fool! Be quiet. Listen to me if you want to save your life.

ff_captain_guild02_4.m: Haha! Sorry lady, but your father wants you back home. I also believe this dirty tavern is no place for a woman like you, haha!
r: Yes, you have to come with me.

thieves_hidden.30: Spoke to dying Crackshot. Remove block road1

Thieves02.2: After completing my first task I'm considered a member of Thieves' Guild. Now I have to perform a very risky task. Umar sent me to kidnap a noble woman from Feygard, without being discovered.
Thieves02.4: She was recently seen in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Thieves02.6: Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern.
Thieves02.10: Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation.
Thieves02.15: I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie.
Thieves02.20: I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild.
Thieves02.21: I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution.
Thieves02.24: Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her.
Thieves02.30: I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous.
Thieves02.35: Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker.
Thieves02.40: I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage.
Thieves02.45: Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up.
Thieves02.50: I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.
Thieves02.55: I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.
Thieves02.60: Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again.
Thieves02.65: I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.
Thieves02.70: The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job.
Thieves02.75: I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work.
Thieves02.76: Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again.
